body:
Tap a rider (they slow down, say one line, ride on). Never the same line twice in a row.

CODY (friendly, walks): "Howdy, neighbour!" / "The trail is extra pretty today." / "Did you see the cows by the big trees?"
HANK (calm, slow jog): "Easy does it." / "This old horse knows every turn." / "Mind the mud by the pigs!"
ROSE (fast, lopes): "Race you to the farm arch!" / "Stan taught me to jump too!" / "Yee-haw! See you around!"
Player on a horse too: all three: "Nice horse! Ride with us!"

Not riders who teach: lessons are Stan only.
short: Cody, Hank, Rose say hi from their horses on the trail
title: Riders Cody, Hank, Rose: lines
